corrected_drift.crates/trady-application/src/README.md: Qualified local model-lab persistence and separated force/cadence bypass from the narrow legacy parser retry exception.
corrected_drift.crates/trady-cli/src/README.md: Corrected the child reply timer boundary: process launch, I/O setup and enqueue precede the monotonic wait timer.
corrected_drift.crates/trady-storage/README.md: Corrected assessment invalidation timing and retention clamping to the observation deadline.
corrected_drift.crates/trady-storage/src/README.md: Corrected changed-content invalidation codes, assessment invalidation timing and retention clamping.
corrected_drift.lab/evaluator/README.md: Corrected missing-payoff behavior and qualified the owner/mode checks on existing diagnostic directories.
corrected_drift.lab/lean/README.md: Corrected executable hashing to construction time rather than each request.
corrected_drift.lab/proofs/README.md: Qualified Lean account/reference validation, private dispatch and caller-supplied revision bindings.
corrected_drift.lab/proofs/TradyProof/README.md: Qualified account-reference validation: account identity, mode, side and the complete status allowlist are outside these checks.
corrected_drift.migrations/README.md: Corrected role/function grants, nullable validation boundaries, financial constraints, confirmation/readiness checks and explicit intelligence erasure behavior.

corrected_drift.services/runtime/README.md: Qualified evaluator isolation: permitting AF_UNIX alone does not deny PostgreSQL Unix sockets.
